headline: A law that names a post office building in Fayetteville, New York, after George H. Bacel.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 599 East Genesee Street in Fayetteville, New York, as the George H. Bacel Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or how the building operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021, and the renaming took effect on that date.
